idea: Current is voltage divided by resistance: more voltage pushes more current round a circuit, and more resistance lets less through.

parameters.name: voltage
parameters.why: From one cell to a car battery: safe, everyday voltages.

parameters.name: resistance
parameters.why: A tenfold range, so the current changes clearly; zero resistance would short the battery.

moves: Dashes on the wires flow round the loop at a speed set by the current; the resistor glows brighter as it gives off more power.
steps: Double the voltage, double the current
The resistor turns energy into heat
